title: Remotely unplugging a USB device on my Mac, without touching it
content:
Tonight I was remote debugging a USB-C device with custom firmware, which was plugged into my Mac Studio at work. I was accessing it over a WireGuard VPN tunnel.

Part of the debugging process involves flashing firmware to the device using MIDI SysEx messages, and while handy, this technique can also be flaky, leaving the device in a partially-flashed state that needs a physical re-plug to recover from.
